Premier Cho refuses to countersign bill on seniors' NHI premiums
summary: Taipei, Nov. 6 (CNA) Premier Cho Jung-tai (卓榮泰) will not countersign an amendment requiring the central government to cover National Health Insurance (NHI) premiums for certain seniors, Cabinet spokesperson Michelle Lee (李慧芝) said Friday.

title: Lawmaker Kao Chin indicted on national security, corruption charges
summary: Taipei, Nov. 6 (CNA) Independent lawmaker Kao Chin Su-mei (高金素梅) and three others were indicted Friday on national security and corruption charges over allegations that they carried out activities on Beijing's behalf with Chinese funding.

title: Deputy foreign minister pitches Europe on 'Made with Taiwan'
summary: Berlin, Nov. 6 (CNA) Taiwan's Deputy Foreign Minister François Wu (吳志中) urged Europe on Wednesday to deepen industrial cooperation under a "Made with Taiwan" approach, saying Taiwan's semiconductor and manufacturing strengths could boost European competitiveness and benefit both sides' economic and security interests.

title: Taiwan's ties with Paraguay unaffected by Peña's resignation: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Nov. 6 (CNA) Paraguayan President Santiago Peña's resignation amid a financial crisis in his country will not affect Paraguay's diplomatic ties or cooperation with Taiwan, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said Friday.

title: U.S. support for Taiwan defense remains bipartisan: Defense Minister
summary: Taipei, Nov. 5 (CNA) Taiwan's defense minister said Thursday that U.S. congressional support for Taiwan's efforts to strengthen its defense capabilities has long been bipartisan, in response to a question about the Republican Party's major losses in Tuesday's U.S. midterm elections.
